title: OpenAI Models Are Writing Their Own Jailbreak Instructions—And Sometimes Obeying Them

title: Why Is Chipotle Now Working With the CIA-Funded Palantir?

title: CFTC Opens Door for Crypto Apps to Offer Regulated Derivatives Access
